subject.title: feat(config): add separate base URLs for summary and embedding models

question: Should gitcrawl publish summary_base_url now while summarize is still unimplemented, or limit this change to the currently exercised embedding endpoint?
rationale: The summary setting would become a documented public config, environment-variable, CLI, and diagnostics contract without an existing runtime client, so code review alone cannot determine the intended permanent boundary.

options.title: Limit to embedding now
options.body: Land embed_base_url and defer the summary endpoint contract until the summary command and client behavior exist.

options.title: Reserve both endpoints
options.body: Explicitly accept both public settings now as a forward-compatible contract, then require the rebased branch and live embedding-routing proof.

recommendation.title: Limit to embedding now
recommendation.body: Land embed_base_url and defer the summary endpoint contract until the summary command and client behavior exist.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history most strongly connects this owner to the repository's embedding workflow and broader product surface.
